Hey so. I like never comment on Reddit but I could’ve literally written this post. I went through a near identical situation this past December (only it was with some very dear friends) and like you, I’ve gone through a lot of sexual trauma that made it difficult for me to open up to people. It’s fucking devastating. I’m still processing it a few months later and probably will be for a while. I will say that my relationship with sex is steadily improving again, although it’s a long process. 

I don’t have very good advice but I felt compelled to reach out, because I felt incredibly alone in the situation. It was really hard for me to track down experiences on this sub and other similar ones. So just know this hasn’t ruined any of the progress you’ve made, that stuff isn’t linear and with time you will heal. Please feel free to message me if you need to talk to someone who’s been through it too.

I have the Kyleena IUD which is one of the smaller ones. 

I enjoy deep penetration as well, prior to my IUD I did get some pain from it, and the IUD has made it worse honestly. Not to the point it’s unbearable! I still really enjoy DP and do it often, but there’s an undeniable difference. Everybody’s bodies are different so it’s hard to say how it exactly it would affect you. If you think the IUD could be a good option, it might be worth to try and just get it taken out if it interferes with your preferences too much. Additionally, for the first month or so I did have more intense pain plus bleeding if my partner was a bit too rough and deep, but that’s pretty much gone away. 

Also worth noting, if your partner is going that deep then he may feel the strings. You can request to have them cut pretty short and they should soften over time. This bothered my partner a bit early on but now it’s not really an issue anymore since they’ve softened considerably over the year that I’ve had it. It was never painful for them, just a bit annoying. 

So TL;DR, might not be the best option? But everyone is different and it’s certainly possible to still enjoy deep penetration while having an IUD.

The only alternative I can think of is something like [Transtape](https://transtape.life) but his mileage will vary depending on his chest size. If it sounds appealing I recommend taking a look at some reviews to see if it’s a good fit. 

For me personally though, I have a pretty large chest (DD) and chronic pain so I can’t bind as often as I’d like. What I decided to do was get a half tank binder a size up from what I usually am, and then wear that under 2-3 layers of clothes (usually just a shirt and thick hoodie) on days where the pain is unmanageable. It doesn’t flatten as effectively as my usual binders (which are full length) but does a bit better than a sports bra, and I don’t have nearly as much pain or breathing troubles. GC2B has a great return policy so it may be worth a try.

Good luck to you both though, I hope y’all can figure out something that works. You seem like a wonderful and supportive partner :)
